Congressman Bishop highlights a critical issue: physical therapy access is crippled by insurance caps and bureaucratic bloat. Insurers routinely limit sessions to 20-30 per year—even for severe cases like spinal injuries—forcing patients to choose between recovery or financial ruin. Case in point: UnitedHealthcare denied Katie Kriegshauser further PT after 30 visits despite her needing mobility to care for her newborn.

Meanwhile, billions flow to foreign aid pet projects like the Pakistan Democracy Act (H.R. 2311) while Americans ration rehab. Real healthcare reform means slashing insurer red tape, reallocating wasted funds to domestic priorities, and mandating coverage that matches medical need—not profit margins.

Cut the bureaucracy, fund recovery, not globalist handouts.

The numbers and stories behind this crisis demand attention—see the evidence laid out: https://t.co/kpUWdvlX0l

The Big Beautiful Bill is a historic reset—cutting globalist bloat to fund American priorities. Premium spikes? Blame decades of Medicaid fraud, bureaucratic waste, and Big Pharma’s price-gouging. The real issue? Corrupt hospital billing, $150B in annual Medicare fraud, and corporate-government collusion driving up costs.

This bill stops subsidizing foreign freeloaders and forces DC to finally prioritize Americans first. Want lower premiums? Audit hospital admin bloat, break pharma monopolies, and end the $2.4T medical billing scam.

Real reform starts with accountability—not more taxpayer-funded handouts to a broken system.
